text:
nina: Heads-up: Orion Labs wants Redwood to be a drop-in for their current vendor (HeliosAPI). They want minimal SDK changes, identical request/response shapes (sync + webhook async), and answers to a short security checklist by Friday. Can we run a POC?
kai: In principle yes. Main compatibility gaps: top-level fields (`context` vs `input`/`messages`), streaming framing (Helios chunked JSON lines), webhook callback shape, and some legacy error codes. We'll need a proxy shim.
omar: +1. Also Helios uses `dedupe_key` for idempotency and returns `X-Helios-Limit` headers; clients rely on those. Shim must preserve or synthesize them.
lucy: security notes: Orion is HIPAA. They require a BAA, KMS details, audit retention options, and mTLS for management APIs. For Hosted we can provide a BAA and Redwood-managed KMS; Dedicated supports customer-managed keys and mTLS. I'll own the questionnaire.
prin: (privsec-bot) Reminder: do not accept customer-supplied long-lived tokens on hosted infra. Use an auth proxy pattern.
nina: customer pasted a sample sync request and async callback. sync: `POST /v2/complete {"context":"Pt note...","max_length":300,"callback_url":"https://orion/cb"}`. callback: `POST /cb {"job_id":"j1","status":"done","result":{"summary":"..."},"meta":{"request_id":"r1"}}`.
kai: Plan: 1) build small compatibility proxy that accepts Helios routes, translates payloads and headers, and maps errors; 2) run parity evaluation on N=60 clinical notes (customer to provide canonical set); 3) pilot for 30 days with fallback routing to Helios if drift > threshold; 4) finalize pricing (pilot credit or short-term blended rate).
omar: I'll sketch the proxy (go/http) - ETA 2 business days with sample cURLs and token mapping. It will: map `context->input`, honor `dedupe_key` as idempotency key, transform SSE -> chunked JSON frames, and map Redwood errors to Helios codes (422/409).
lucy: Auth approach: Hosted: auth-proxy validates Helios tokens, mints ephemeral Redwood tokens, logs mapping. Dedicated: support mTLS / customer tokens. I'll prepare questionnaire answers and BAA options.
privsec-bot: (automated) Uploaded checklist to https://redwood-internal/company/orion/presales.
deploy-bot: deploy started by omar for branch shim/orion-compat at commit f7d9a - staging proxy: https://staging-proxy.redwood.net/helios/v2/complete
omar: Staging up. Basic sync flows pass. Streaming wrapper needs final EOF frame fix.
kai: For parity: note Helios applies a post-processing PHI scrubber that alters outputs. We can emulate but must tell customer it's best-effort. Acceptance metric should be clinical-entity F1 + manual review.
nina: Pricing ask: They want existing per-req price for first 60 days. Sales can offer a pilot credit or temporary blended rate. Finance to confirm.
omar: Action items: omar -> prototype shim and staging endpoint, kai -> run parity eval on 60 examples once customer shares them, lucy -> questionnaire & BAA, nina -> SOW + pricing ask to finance.
nina: I'll email Orion with the proposed POC plan and request canonical prompt set + metric thresholds. Will update thread when we get their data. :thumbsup:
